check.label: Address detail check
check.help: An address with none of these words (house, road, para, village …) is still taken as an order — it is never held — but it gets the "address check" flag and a call task, so the confirmation call asks for directions. Add or remove words in English, Banglish and Bengali. Switch it off and no address is flagged this way.

backfill.label: Silent address backfill
backfill.help: When a customer writes an address with no area in it ("Road 12, House 42") and his phone number is already known, he is not asked Inside or Outside Dhaka: the charge comes from the address we hold, nothing is shown or filled in on his page, what he typed stays as he typed it, and the full address we hold is attached to the order for packing. An address that names its own area always wins. "From orders": use his delivered orders (or any order not cancelled or returned) when he has no saved address. Off: he is asked as usual.

gift.label: Gift mode
gift.help: "Send as a gift" in the bag opens the checkout as a gift. The name, phone and address are the receiver's (the sticker and the courier use them); the sender writes his own name and a contact for updates (a phone of any country or an e-mail). A gift note, a "deliver on or after" date and "hide prices on the invoice" go with it. Advance: when required, "full" means the whole gift is paid ahead (Cash on Delivery is not offered); "fixed amount" or "percentage" take part ahead — until part payment comes, the team gets a call task to collect it. Note length 0 or date days 0 hides that box. Off: no gift link anywhere.

advance.label: Checkout advance (Parameter for Checkout)
advance.help: The one switch of the advance-payment checkout mode and the most layers its panel takes. Off: every customer sees the checkout as before. On: a customer one of your layers flags — and only once he has filled in his name, phone and address — sees bKash, Nagad and card without Cash on Delivery, with one plain line saying what to pay now (the delivery charge, a part or the full amount, as his layer asks); he never sees a score or a reason. The order waits for that advance and comes back to the queue once it is paid; it is never cancelled or blocked by itself. No price, charge or discount changes. The layers are set on Orders › Risk rules › Checkout advance.

addOn.label: Add to this parcel
addOn.help: Lets a customer add a piece to his own Cash on Delivery order from the thank-you page or his order page, as a real order line that goes in the same parcel. It is priced as its product page prices it; nothing already on the order is priced again, and the amount to pay at the door grows by exactly that piece. "Until": while the order is new, or also after it is confirmed (until picking starts). Never after a courier is booked. "Minutes after placing": 0 means no time limit besides that. "Lines" and "pieces": how many he may add. Off: the thank-you page shows no add buttons.

look.label: Complete your look (thank-you page)
look.help: Shows up to "how many" pieces under the order on the thank-you page, taken only from your running combos and sets that hold a product of his order (the ones customers pick most come first). While "Add to this parcel" is on and open for his order, each has an Add button that puts it in the same parcel. No combo with his product: the block is not shown. Off: never shown.
